name: Buildings (OpenStreetMap)
description: Reads the building footprints, heights and levels around the point from OpenStreetMap through the Overpass service (ODbL: credit OpenStreetMap contributors). It asks the service only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; nothing is sent at start-up, no key is used, and the answer is kept 24 hours in this browser.
author: CadCraft
